stats._comment: Set 'merged' to your all-time merged PR count across apache/flink* repos (run: gh search prs --author=FeatZhang --merged --owner=apache --limit=1000 --json url | jq length)

dailyContributions._comment: Optional. Map of YYYY-MM-DD -> count. Counts can include commits/PRs/reviews/comments combined. If omitted, the dashboard will infer activity from PR updatedAt + mailing-list dates. Populate via: gh api graphql -f query='{user(login:"FeatZhang"){contributionsCollection{contributionCalendar{weeks{contributionDays{date contributionCount}}}}}}' | jq -r ...

unrepliedIssues._comment: Open FLINK JIRA issues with 0 comments. Populate via: curl -sG 'https://issues.apache.org/jira/rest/api/2/search' --data-urlencode 'jql=project = FLINK AND resolution = Unresolved AND comments < 1 ORDER BY created DESC' --data-urlencode 'fields=summary,created,priority,components,labels,reporter' --data-urlencode 'maxResults=200' | jq '[.issues[]|{key,summary:.fields.summary,url:("https://issues.apache.org/jira/browse/"+.key),createdAt:.fields.created,priority:.fields.priority.name,components:[.fields.components[].name],labels:.fields.labels,reporter:.fields.reporter.displayName}]'

crTargets._comment: Open Flink PRs (NOT authored by you) in SQL/Table or AI/Model areas, worth reviewing actively. Populate via: gh search prs --owner=apache 'is:pr is:open archived:false -author:FeatZhang draft:false (sql OR table OR planner OR calcite OR ai OR model OR inference OR mcp) in:title' --limit=80 --json number,title,url,repository,author,updatedAt,labels,isDraft,additions,deletions,reviewDecision | jq '[.[]|{number,title,url,repo:.repository.nameWithOwner,author:.author.login,updatedAt,labels:[.labels[].name],isDraft,additions,deletions,reviewState:((.reviewDecision//"")|ascii_downcase)}]'. Field topic (sql|ai|other) is auto-inferred from title/module/labels keywords if omitted.
